decisions.name: DataFlow Analytics
decisions.rationale: DataFlow exceeds all scale criteria: health score 84 (>75), traction score 87 (>75), monthly growth 18% (>15%), CAC/LTV ratio 0.167 (<0.3), runway 18 months (>12). Previous decision (scale) is tracking well with improving trend. Strong team, market validation evident (62 NPS), and unit economics support growth investment. Ready for acceleration.

decisions.name: MediLink Connect
decisions.rationale: MediLink shows exceptional traction growth (35% MoM, traction score 78) but does not meet all scale criteria: health score 72 (<75 threshold), regulatory risk flag, key hire gaps. Strong trajectory warrants continued investment, but execution risk and compliance requirements require iteration before scaling. Recommend: (1) Fill critical compliance engineering role, (2) Build regulatory roadmap and compliance infrastructure, (3) Validate healthcare customer segment assumptions, (4) Re-evaluate in 6 weeks. If regulatory barriers resolved and team strengthened, may qualify for scale decision.

next_milestones.success_criteria: Role filled, person onboarded, regulatory roadmap developed
Assess if scale criteria can be met by next review cycle

risk_flags: Regulatory compliance requirements could delay growth
Team gaps in compliance expertise need immediate attention
Healthcare market has longer sales cycles - verify CAC trend sustainable

decisions.name: TruckRoute Pro
decisions.rationale: TruckRoute Pro meets multiple kill criteria and should be terminated. (1) CAC/LTV ratio 0.778 exceeds 2x LTV threshold (CAC $2,800 vs LTV $3,600 = 0.778) with no improving trajectory after 6 weeks of stable metrics. (2) Minimal traction: conversion rate 3%, growth 5% MoM at 32 weeks post-launch represents stagnation. (3) Health declining (score 45, trend declining) and traction weak (score 38). (4) Runway critical at 8 months with unsustainable burn ($75K monthly against $2K revenue). Team velocity declining, market competition intense, core go-to-market hypothesis appears disproven. Recommendation: Execute orderly wind-down with 6-week timeline, extract learning for supply chain vertical, preserve team relationships.

summary.portfolio_narrative: Q2 governance cycle shows portfolio bifurcation: DataFlow Analytics continues strong growth trajectory and is approved for scaling with budget increase. MediLink Connect demonstrates exceptional traction but requires focused iteration on regulatory compliance before scale decision. TruckRoute Pro meets multiple kill criteria and is recommended for orderly wind-down. Overall portfolio impact: +$20K to DataFlow, +$10K to MediLink, -$55K from TruckRoute = net -$25K burn reduction. Recommend human review of kill decision and scale decision before implementation. Next portfolio review: 2 weeks post-decision to monitor execution.
